title: Final Answer
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct expression for the ground state energy shift, Delta E.

title: Kinetic Energy Relation
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly state the relativistic relation between kinetic energy and momentum.

title: Perturbation Approach
description: Important Criteria: The student must recognize and apply the perturbation method to find the energy shift.

title: Integral Setup
description: Important Criteria: The student should set up the integral correctly for calculating the expectation value of the perturbation.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must avoid sign mistakes in the perturbation term and the final expression for Delta E.

title: Units Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student should check that all units are consistent throughout the derivation.

title: Expansion Accuracy
description: Important Criteria: The student must accurately perform the Taylor expansion to the correct order in c.

title: Normalization Factor
description: Optional Criteria: The student should mention or verify the normalization factor of the wave function used in the integral.
